_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Acquiring Credentials#000.src: Oh, an egg! I'll pay you {~} emeralds for it, of course!
Acquiring Credentials#000.dst: 噢，一顆蛋！我當然會付你 {~} 綠寶石買下它！
Acquiring Credentials#000.speaker:
Black Market Merchant
[Bid Increase: 50 Emeralds]

Acquiring Credentials#001.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 取得 Gavel 護照

Acquiring Credentials#002.src: I'm sorry sir, but I can't just give you a new passport... You'd need approval from-...
Acquiring Credentials#002.dst: 很抱歉先生，我不能就這樣發一本新護照給你……你需要取得——
Acquiring Credentials#002.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#003.src: But sir, my passport was stolen! I have a flight to {p} in under {~} minutes. I really need one, quick...
Acquiring Credentials#003.dst: 可是先生，我的護照被偷了！我還有不到 {~} 分鐘就要搭飛船去 {p}。我真的急需一本……
Acquiring Credentials#003.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#004.src: I've already told you where you need to go to get a new one. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#004.dst: 我已經跟你說過要去哪裡辦新的了。下一位，麻煩。
Acquiring Credentials#004.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#005.src: Hmmm... {u}, is it? Unfortunately, humans are required to get their passports in Wynn.
Acquiring Credentials#005.dst: 嗯……你是 {u}，對吧？很遺憾，人類必須在 Wynn 辦護照。
Acquiring Credentials#005.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#006.src: I'm afraid I can't help you. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#006.dst: 恐怕我幫不上忙。下一位，麻煩。
Acquiring Credentials#006.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#007.src: Hey, you! Yes, you! Come outside, would you? I think we can help each other.
Acquiring Credentials#007.dst: 喂，你！對，就是你！可以出來一下嗎？我想我們可以互相幫忙。
Acquiring Credentials#007.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#008.src: So, I overheard your conversation with the Officer... You're also looking for a passport, right?
Acquiring Credentials#008.dst: 我剛才不小心聽到你跟官員的對話……你也在找護照，對吧？
Acquiring Credentials#008.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#009.src: Well...so, I've heard rumours of a secret Black Market that hides in the airbase.
Acquiring Credentials#009.dst: 是這樣的……我聽過一些傳聞，說空軍基地裡藏著一個祕密黑市。
Acquiring Credentials#009.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#010.src: Let's explore the airbase, then! We need to look for clues, lead the way.
Acquiring Credentials#010.speaker: Cinfras Citizen 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿢 󐀂

Acquiring Credentials#011.src: Apparently they trade illegal products... There has to be a way of buying passports, I'm sure of it!
Acquiring Credentials#011.dst: 據說他們在那裡買賣違禁品……那裡一定有辦法買到護照，我很確定！
Acquiring Credentials#011.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#012.src: If we work together, we might be able to find a way in. What do you think?
Acquiring Credentials#012.dst: 如果我們合作，說不定就能找到進去的門路。你覺得呢？
Acquiring Credentials#012.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#013.src: Explore the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#013.dst: 探索空軍基地，尋找黑市的線索。

Acquiring Credentials#014.src: Oh, you brought us to the Inn! Hmmm, the Barman's been working here for a long time...
Acquiring Credentials#014.dst: 喔，你把我們帶到旅店來了！嗯，酒保在這裡做很久了……
Acquiring Credentials#014.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#015.src: Maybe he knows something about the Black Market! I'll try and ask, y'know...all, uh...sneaky-like.
Acquiring Credentials#015.dst: 說不定他知道黑市的事！我來問問看，你知道的……用那種，呃……鬼鬼祟祟的方式。
Acquiring Credentials#015.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#016.src: I can't believe this place! They only have some rancid wheat stored here, what am I supposed to do with that? I'll take a carrot any day over... wheat.
Acquiring Credentials#016.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

Acquiring Credentials#017.src: All those other airship men carry around those vile face fruits, but I have to say, I've always had a soft spot for potatoes.
Acquiring Credentials#017.speaker:
Airship Commander
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Acquiring Credentials#018.src: I wish my airship was black, I can't say I'm a fan of that white palette...
Acquiring Credentials#018.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

Acquiring Credentials#020.src: You know, maybe white isn't so bad after all.
Acquiring Credentials#020.speaker:
Airship Commander
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Acquiring Credentials#021.src: It turns out, white's actually quite a nice colour.
Acquiring Credentials#021.speaker:
Airship Commander
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Acquiring Credentials#022.src: ... Oh, fine, wheat's not bad. I'll take some, I guess.
Acquiring Credentials#022.speaker:
Airship Commander
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Acquiring Credentials#024.src: Though, really, the face doesn't mean it has to be evil, does it? It could be a nice face, after all.

Acquiring Credentials#025.src: Excuse me, sir... You, uh...wouldn't happen to know any really cheap stores around here, would you?
Acquiring Credentials#025.dst: 不好意思，先生……你，呃……該不會剛好知道這附近有什麼真的很便宜的店吧？
Acquiring Credentials#025.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#026.src: The table's been set for the great feast, have stout or beer, what will it be?
Acquiring Credentials#026.dst: 盛宴的桌子已經擺好，要黑啤還是啤酒，你選哪一個？
Acquiring Credentials#026.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#027.src: Is that a secret code...? Beer?
Acquiring Credentials#027.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#028.src: Did that work? Is he gonna let us in?
Acquiring Credentials#028.dst: 有用嗎？他會放我們進去嗎？
Acquiring Credentials#028.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#029.src: I guess it wouldn't be that easy to find a way in... Where do you think we can go with that lead, {u}?
Acquiring Credentials#029.dst: 我想要找到門路本來就不會那麼容易……{u}，你覺得從這條線索還能往哪查？
Acquiring Credentials#029.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#030.src: Let's just keep exploring. Lead the way.
Acquiring Credentials#030.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#031.src: Keep exploring the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#031.dst: 繼續探索空軍基地，尋找黑市的線索。

Acquiring Credentials#033.src: Hey, uh...do these people look suspicious to you, too?
Acquiring Credentials#033.dst: 欸，呃……你也覺得這些人看起來很可疑嗎？
Acquiring Credentials#033.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#034.src: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#034.dst: 飛船指揮官愛的正是他們恨的。
Acquiring Credentials#034.speaker: Waiter

Acquiring Credentials#035.src: I think we're getting onto something! Let's keep going.
Acquiring Credentials#035.dst: 我想我們摸到門路了！繼續走吧。
Acquiring Credentials#035.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#036.src: Follow the clue: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#036.dst: 追查線索: 飛船指揮官愛的正是他們恨的。

Acquiring Credentials#037.src: Hmmm... These crates are full of items. Maybe we could give some of them to the commanders?
Acquiring Credentials#037.dst: 嗯……這些箱子裡裝滿了東西。也許我們可以拿一些給指揮官？
Acquiring Credentials#037.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#038.src: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#038.dst: 一旦撕裂，便永遠無法修補。
Acquiring Credentials#038.speaker: Commander

Acquiring Credentials#039.src: Oh, let's keep going! Where can we go with that lead?
Acquiring Credentials#039.dst: 喔，我們繼續吧！這條線索能帶我們去哪？
Acquiring Credentials#039.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#040.src: Follow the clue: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#040.dst: 追查線索: 一旦撕裂，便永遠無法修補。

Acquiring Credentials#041.src: Who's that on top of that platform?!
Acquiring Credentials#041.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#042.src: The two of you have come real far for this, huh?
Acquiring Credentials#042.dst: 你們兩個為了這件事跑了不少路啊？
Acquiring Credentials#042.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#043.src: Well, I can give you the answer to the stout and beer question! But you won't enter the Market just with that.
Acquiring Credentials#043.dst: 好吧，黑啤跟啤酒那題的答案我可以告訴你們！但光靠那個進不了黑市。
Acquiring Credentials#043.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#044.src: You see, to enter the Market you'll need something to sell! And it won't be something you can exactly buy around here, if you get what I mean.
Acquiring Credentials#044.dst: 你要知道，要進黑市，你得有東西可以賣！而且那東西，怎麼說呢，不會是你在這附近買得到的，你懂我意思吧。
Acquiring Credentials#044.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#045.dst: 我們需要……違法的東西，對吧？
Acquiring Credentials#045.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#046.src: Exactly! Luckily for you, I'm in a good mood. There's an airship docked close by. We'll be able to take it and I can help you get an item.
Acquiring Credentials#046.dst: 正是！算你們走運，我今天心情不錯。附近停著一艘飛船。我們可以把它開走，我來幫你們弄到一樣東西。
Acquiring Credentials#046.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#047.src: Uh... What do you think, {u}? I really need that passport, and well...you could get something out of this too, right?
Acquiring Credentials#047.dst: 呃……{u}，你覺得呢？我真的很需要那本護照，而且，嗯……你也能從中拿到點什麼，對吧？
Acquiring Credentials#047.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#048.src: Protect me while I harvest the egg, soldier!
Acquiring Credentials#048.speaker:
Mechanic
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

similar.text: Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!

Acquiring Credentials#050.src: Great! Follow me, it's not far.
Acquiring Credentials#050.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#052.src: Wait! There are guards protecting the airship. Don't let them see you!
Acquiring Credentials#052.dst: 等等！有守衛在看著那艘飛船。別讓他們看見你！
Acquiring Credentials#052.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#053.src: They're near the edge... Push them off.
Acquiring Credentials#053.dst: 他們就站在邊緣……把他們推下去。
Acquiring Credentials#053.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#054.src: Uhh... I'm sure they're fine, I'm sure that fall wasn't too big...
Acquiring Credentials#054.dst: 呃……我相信他們沒事，我相信那個高度摔不死人……
Acquiring Credentials#054.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#055.src: Well, that's your only way inside! There are more guards up ahead. Take care of them without being seen, and we'll be in the clear!
Acquiring Credentials#055.dst: 好，那就是你唯一進得去的路了！前面還有更多守衛。別被發現，把他們解決掉，我們就沒問題了！
Acquiring Credentials#055.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#056.src: Well done! Let's get on the airship.
Acquiring Credentials#056.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#057.src: Did you just... Push them all...?
Acquiring Credentials#057.dst: 你剛剛是不是……把他們全都推下去了……？
Acquiring Credentials#057.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#058.src: Buckle up! We're heading to the {p}, there we'll be able to collect some dragonling eggs for you to sell at the Black Market!
Acquiring Credentials#058.dst: 坐穩了！我們要前往 {p}，在那裡可以弄到一些 Dragonling 蛋，讓你拿去黑市賣！
Acquiring Credentials#058.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#059.src: Travel with the Mechanic and Doan to the {p} to get the Dragonling Egg.
Acquiring Credentials#059.dst: 與技師和 Doan 一同前往 {p} 取得 Dragonling 蛋。

Acquiring Credentials#060.src: The island we're heading to is home to a Dragonling nest! They use it to lay their eggs, as it's quite a difficult place to access.
Acquiring Credentials#060.dst: 我們要去的那座島是 Dragonling 的巢穴！牠們在那裡產卵，因為那地方很難抵達。
Acquiring Credentials#060.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#061.src: And those'll be worth a lot in the Black Market, right...?
Acquiring Credentials#061.dst: 那些東西在黑市上應該很值錢吧……？
Acquiring Credentials#061.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#062.src: They sure will! Dragonling eggs are rare, and this island can only be accessed by airship... They're worth a fortune back at Letvus.
Acquiring Credentials#062.dst: 當然值錢！Dragonling 蛋很稀有，而那座島只能靠飛船抵達……在 Letvus 那邊，它們可值一大筆錢。
Acquiring Credentials#062.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#063.src: Oh, there it is! I can see the island from here, buckle up. We've got some eggs to steal!
Acquiring Credentials#063.dst: 喔，就在那裡！我從這裡就看得到那座島了，坐穩。我們有幾顆蛋要偷！
Acquiring Credentials#063.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#064.src: What's that?! Oh... It looks like we've got company...
Acquiring Credentials#064.dst: 那是什麼？！喔……看來有人跟我們搶了……
Acquiring Credentials#064.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#065.src: Drat, the skyraiders are here! We can't let them get away with those eggs...
Acquiring Credentials#065.dst: 糟了，Skyraider 也來了！我們不能讓他們把那些蛋帶走……
Acquiring Credentials#065.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#066.src: Well, if that's the case, then there's only one thing to do! Come on, follow me!
Acquiring Credentials#066.dst: 好，既然如此，那就只有一條路可走了！來，跟我來！
Acquiring Credentials#066.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#067.src: We can't get to the nest with so many pirates on the way, kill them!
Acquiring Credentials#067.dst: 路上這麼多海盜，我們到不了巢穴，把他們殺光！
Acquiring Credentials#067.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#068.src: Alright, follow me! Let's go harvest that egg!
Acquiring Credentials#068.dst: 好，跟我來！我們去採那顆蛋！
Acquiring Credentials#068.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#069.src: Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!
Acquiring Credentials#069.dst: 人類，我採蛋的時候保護我！
Acquiring Credentials#069.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#070.src: We're halfway there, just keep defending me!
Acquiring Credentials#070.dst: 我們完成一半了，繼續掩護我！
Acquiring Credentials#070.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#071.src: There we go! Let's get back to the airship, run!
Acquiring Credentials#071.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#072.src: Don't let them get away! Fire the cannons!!
Acquiring Credentials#072.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#073.src: Soldier, don't let them hit us! Attack the cannonballs using your weapon before they hit our airship to deflect them!
Acquiring Credentials#073.dst: 士兵，別讓他們打中我們！在砲彈擊中飛船之前用你的武器打掉它，把它彈開！
Acquiring Credentials#073.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#074.src: We can't take more cannon shots... We're wasting our time, let's get going! We got bigger fish to fry!
Acquiring Credentials#074.dst: 我們再挨幾砲就撐不住了……別在這浪費時間，我們走！還有更大的獵物等著呢！
Acquiring Credentials#074.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#075.src: That was close... Well then, let's head back to the airbase!
Acquiring Credentials#075.dst: 好險……那麼，我們回空軍基地吧！
Acquiring Credentials#075.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#076.src: Go back to the bar at the Blackbird Inn with Doan.
Acquiring Credentials#076.dst: 和 Doan 一起回到 Blackbird Inn 的酒吧。

Acquiring Credentials#077.src: The two of you have certainly proven yourselves today!
Acquiring Credentials#077.dst: 你們兩個今天確實證明了自己！
Acquiring Credentials#077.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#078.src: So, I'll give you the password to enter the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#078.dst: 那麼，我把進黑市的暗號告訴你們。
Acquiring Credentials#078.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#079.src: Go back to the Barman at the Inn and tell him 'I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.'
Acquiring Credentials#079.dst: 回旅店找酒保，跟他說我不渴，我隨身都帶著一瓶。
Acquiring Credentials#079.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#080.src: That might just give you the chance you need to get in. Good luck!
Acquiring Credentials#080.dst: 這樣應該就能給你們一個進去的機會了。祝好運！
Acquiring Credentials#080.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#081.src: Thank you for your help, sir... Let's go back to the bar, then.
Acquiring Credentials#081.dst: 謝謝你的幫忙，先生……那我們回酒吧吧。
Acquiring Credentials#081.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#082.src: Here we are again. Let's talk to the Barman.
Acquiring Credentials#082.dst: 我們又回來了。去跟酒保說話吧。
Acquiring Credentials#082.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#083.src: Um, sir? I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.
Acquiring Credentials#083.dst: 那個，先生？我不渴，我隨身都帶著一瓶。
Acquiring Credentials#083.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#084.src: ...Well, hey there... Would you like to buy some... potions?

Acquiring Credentials#085.src: Well, hello there! You like you could use some of my fine wares, yes!

Acquiring Credentials#086.src: A dragonling egg? I'd pay {~} emeralds for it.
Acquiring Credentials#086.speaker:
Black Market Merchant
[Bid Increase: 300 Emeralds]

Acquiring Credentials#087.src: So that's our initial bid. Now we need to ask for a higher bid, remember? We can't always talk to the same merchant or they'll lose interest...
Acquiring Credentials#087.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

Acquiring Credentials#088.src: And we can't talk to more than {~} people for a raise or they might get angry.
Acquiring Credentials#088.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

Acquiring Credentials#089.src: Well! We really don't see many dragonling eggs around here, not at all!! I'll give you {~} emeralds for it, how does that sound?!
Acquiring Credentials#089.speaker:
Black Market Merchant
[Bid Increase: 150 Emeralds]

Acquiring Credentials#090.src: Fine! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds. But if this egg isn't mine now? Don't bother coming back.
Acquiring Credentials#090.speaker:
Black Market Merchant
[Bid Increase: 300 Emeralds]

Acquiring Credentials#091.src: Remember what the passport seller said? We shouldn't always talk to the same merchant... I think this one won't like another price raise. We should talk to the others.

Acquiring Credentials#092.src: An egg, eh... I'd pay you... {~} emeralds, for it.

Acquiring Credentials#093.src: Another price hike?! I'm not interested anymore. Scram.

Acquiring Credentials#094.src: Is that a dragonling egg I spot? For a rare item such as that, I would of course be willing to pay {~} emeralds for it!
Acquiring Credentials#094.speaker:
Doan
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Acquiring Credentials#096.src: He appears to be rummaging through his documents.

Acquiring Credentials#097.src: We have to get to {~} emeralds in {~} bid increases. Let's try again!

Acquiring Credentials#098.src: You should try to increase the price with another merchant before going back to your previous one.

Acquiring Credentials#099.src: Oh, you're bold, I'll give you that! Asking for another price increase?! Fine!! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds!

Acquiring Credentials#100.src: I'll raise that price to... {~} emeralds.

Acquiring Credentials#102.src: ...might not be my business to ask, but what's a human got business at a villager airship customs office for?

Acquiring Credentials#103.src: Talk only to the Black Market member in the end of the hallway and do not talk to anyone else.
Acquiring Credentials#103.dst: 只跟走廊底端的黑市成員說話，別跟任何其他人交談。
Acquiring Credentials#103.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#105.src: Enter the Black Market and talk to the Member at the end of the hallway.
Acquiring Credentials#105.dst: 進入黑市，與走廊底端的成員交談。

Acquiring Credentials#106.src: I've heard you've stolen some eggs from the Skyraiders. That's a bold move!
Acquiring Credentials#106.dst: 我聽說你們從 Skyraider 那裡偷了幾顆蛋。這一手夠大膽！
Acquiring Credentials#106.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#108.src: Two passports? I'd say that's around {~} emeralds. You can get that selling this egg on the market.
Acquiring Credentials#108.dst: 兩本護照？我看差不多要 {~} 綠寶石。把這顆蛋拿去市場上賣就湊得到。
Acquiring Credentials#108.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#109.src: Let me fill you in how the market works. You'll get a low starting price for your egg, and then you'll have to go around the merchants asking for a higher bid.
Acquiring Credentials#109.dst: 我來說明一下這個市場怎麼運作。你的蛋會有一個很低的起價，然後你得四處找商人，設法把價錢往上抬。
Acquiring Credentials#109.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#110.src: Be careful, though, as you can only ask for {~} price increases.
Acquiring Credentials#110.dst: 不過要小心，你最多只能要求 {~} 次加價。
Acquiring Credentials#110.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#111.src: You can try talking to different merchants, and see how much each increases the price of the egg.
Acquiring Credentials#111.dst: 你可以試著跟不同的商人談，看看每個人願意把蛋的價錢抬高多少。
Acquiring Credentials#111.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#112.src: Good luck, and do try not to get killed.
Acquiring Credentials#112.dst: 祝好運，還有，盡量別把自己搞死了。
Acquiring Credentials#112.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#113.src: Talk to the Merchants and try to get {~} emeralds to buy a passport.
Acquiring Credentials#113.dst: 與商人們交談，設法湊到 {~} 綠寶石來買護照。

Acquiring Credentials#114.src: That's what we need, {u}. Sold! The egg is yours.
Acquiring Credentials#114.dst: {u}，這就是我們要的數字。成交！蛋歸你了。
Acquiring Credentials#114.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#115.src: Here, you can have your emeralds.
Acquiring Credentials#115.speaker: Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#117.src: Talk to the Black Market Member again.

Acquiring Credentials#118.src: So do you have the emeralds?
Acquiring Credentials#118.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#119.src: Hmm... This will do it. Here, your passports.
Acquiring Credentials#119.dst: 嗯……這樣就行了。拿去，你們的護照。
Acquiring Credentials#119.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#120.src: Uhh.. {u}, I think you dropped your passport. Let me get it for yo-...
Acquiring Credentials#120.dst: 呃……{u}，你的護照好像掉了。我幫你撿起——
Acquiring Credentials#120.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#121.src: Wait... That's MY passport?! It was in my pocket all along...
Acquiring Credentials#121.dst: 等等……這是「我的」護照？！它一直都在我口袋裡……
Acquiring Credentials#121.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#122.src: Well, uhhh... I guess you can have some of these emeralds, then...
Acquiring Credentials#122.dst: 那個，呃……我想這些綠寶石就分你一些吧……
Acquiring Credentials#122.speaker: Doan
